note: The root key records the consonants of the dictionary form. The boundary description supplies no etymology.
summary: Genesis names Zeboiim alongside Sodom, Gomorrah and Admah in its description of the Canaanite boundary. It later names a king of Zeboiim.

senses.definition: A city named with Admah in the description of the Canaanite boundary.

evidence.note: Zeboiim follows Admah in the list of places along the boundary.
The list of kings identifies Shemeber as king of Zeboiim.
